Attention: Please note our age requirement policy: One (1) parent or guardian over the age of 25 be present and staying in the property for every three (3) guests between the ages of 15 and 25.
Beach Access: Rise and Shine in Inlet Beach is a short .3 mile walk (drive, golf cart, bike ride, and walk) away from the largest public beach access in Walton County, the Inlet Beach Regional Beach Access. Located less than half mile away from the home, with plenty of parking and public restrooms, as well as a lifeguard on-duty (during peak season).
This charming NEW Florida home, is situated in beautiful, sunny, private Inlet Beach neighborhood. Newly constructed with a rejuvenating coastal ambiance, this two-story Florida home offers the peace and tranquility of a perfect coastal getaway. It's prime location, a short skip from Scenic Highway 30A, is just minutes from the powdery-white sugar sands of Rosemary Beach, as well as plenty of shopping, entertainment, and dining options all along County Highway 30A!
Hardwood floors, Granite counter-tops, an expansive patio with outdoor seating (& pegola dining) and it's modern beachy decor are just a few of the features that make this multi-level home a worthwhile escape. The bright & open living room offers comfy furnishings while the dining area offers seating for up to 6 guest, with additional seating for 2 at the breakfast bar. The large, open-plan Living and Dining Room offer plenty of room for entertaining the whole family, with plenty of room on the couch around the large, 70" wall-mounted flat-screen TV!
Upstairs, you'll find 2 guest rooms sharing a beautiful bathroom with a shower/tub combo. One guest room holds King bed and the other holds a King bed and has access to a private, covered balcony with seating. Steaming TV's in every bedroom! Additional full size couch sitting area with large TV and a twin pullout loveseat.
The master bedroom is also located on the second floor; sporting a King-sized bed and a private, luxurious master bathroom, complete with a double vanity and GIGANTIC walk-in shower with rainfall shower-head and a soaking tub.
Rise and Shine at Inlet Beach is conveniently positioned in the community of The Ivy at Inlet Beach, just a block or two away from the Donut Hole (the perfect breakfast spot!) and TONS of restaurants and shopping located at 30Avenue! Beautiful Rosemary and Alys Beach are both an easy bike ride away, and the Inlet Beach access, home to Grouper Reef, is right nearby as well! This BRAND NEW home is a CAN'T MISS OPPORTUNITY that you and your family will want to repeat every year!
30A is a scenic stretch of highway down Florida's beautiful gulf coast between Destin and Panama City Beach. The highway connects the coastal villages of South Walton through the undisturbed beauty of rare dune lakes, sugar white sand, and emerald blue waters indigenous to the area. Each village has its own unique characteristics that paint a fairy tale like scene against some of the country's most beautiful beaches. Come live the 30A life and experience the beach the way it was meant to be, where Southern Charm meets Bohemian lifestyle and unforgettable vacation memories are created.
Nearby Restaurants: Donut Hole, Shaka Sushi and Cocktail Bar, Cafe Aroma, Amigos Mexican Kitchen, Amici Italian, Idyll Hound Proper- Brew Pub/Restaurant, Canopy Road Cafe/Breakfast, Destin Ice Market 30A, fine dining in area, (walking distance: Inlet Beach Shop, UPS, and Urgent care close by as well).

Guests who violate this policy will be charged an additional $500, plus the expense of steam-cleaning and deodorizing. Violations will result in immediate eviction and forfeiture of rent.
